goal: Autonomous Cuphead speedrun agent: latent world model + MPC planner + reflex control, with an LLM strategist for loadout, routing and failure analysis.

current_phase.name: harness
current_phase.exit_criterion: Round-trip input->visible-response latency p50 < 30 ms and p99 < 50 ms, measured over 200 trials; zero duplicate or dropped frames over a 10-minute capture.

phases.name: harness
phases.exit_criterion: latency p50 < 30ms, p99 < 50ms over 200 trials; 0 dup/dropped frames in 10 min capture

phases.name: perception
phases.exit_criterion: HP/card read 100% on 5000 held-out frames; event detector F1 >= 0.95 vs hand labels

phases.name: baseline_and_metrics
phases.exit_criterion: reproducible TTK distribution for target boss over 30 attempts, CI width < 15% of median

phases.name: reflex
phases.exit_criterion: parry conversion >= human median; reflex override precision >= 0.90

phases.name: world_model
phases.exit_criterion: hit-prediction AUC >= 0.85 at k=8 on held-out replays, per boss

phases.name: planner
phases.exit_criterion: median TTK beats phase-2 baseline, bootstrap CI excludes 0, n >= 30, planning latency <= 10 ms

phases.name: strategist
phases.exit_criterion: >= 3 LLM-proposed changes pass the statistical gate; calibration record established

phases.name: route
phases.exit_criterion: full-run assembly with per-segment gold splits tracked

notes: Nothing below phase 0 is meaningful until the harness passes its exit criterion. See docs/SPEEDRUN_PLAN.md section 2. The harness is now code-complete (capture integrity, actuation, the replay format, and a human-demonstration recorder) and self-tested synthetically -- see harness_readiness above. The next action is real: run `python3 scripts/latency_canary.py --real` and `python3 scripts/record_session.py --real --boss <boss> --max-seconds <n>` on the machine actually running Cuphead.

harness_readiness.note: Everything above is code-complete and stdlib/synthetic-tested (see .ai/tasks.json notes on each harness-* task). None of it is VALIDATED yet -- that requires running scripts/latency_canary.py --real and scripts/record_session.py --real on the machine actually running Cuphead. Until then, phase 0's exit criterion is not met and phase 1 stays locked, per the build order in docs/SPEEDRUN_PLAN.md section 9.
